properties.description: At each eligible pre/post observation, occupancy equals the independent expected queue length. Transfers are accepted using pre-edge expected occupancy, including simultaneous operations at full and empty.
Full is asserted exactly when the independent expected queue contains 16 words.
Empty is asserted exactly when the independent expected queue contains zero words.

When the expected queue is nonempty, asynchronous front data equals its oldest accepted word, checking ordering, simultaneous transfers, wraparound, and operation after reset. Empty data is unspecified and not checked.
Public occupancy is known and within zero through 16, and full and empty agree with the public occupancy at every eligible observation.
After a synchronous reset edge, occupancy is zero, full is clear, and empty is asserted, including resets during operation.
